text:
Ella (Partnerships): 48h until marketplace go-live. Quick scrub: what would block launch right now?
Marcus (Product): Listing text, SKUs, and pricing table are final. Need partner logo assets and hero lock.
June (Marketing): Hero PNG ready for EN and mobile crop included. FR/JP still pending. Can we launch EN-first and swap localized later?
Ella (Partnerships): Yes if layout unchanged. Need legal ok on logos.
Ivy (Legal): Partner logos approved except NanoChip. We need signed logo usage addendum from them by EOD tomorrow.
Samir (Eng): Integration tests pass in staging. One flaky tenant create in us-east-2 under load. I'll add a short retry in the client helper and push a patch to staging.
Ruth (Platform): I'll add a soft concurrency cap for onboarding flows to protect dedicated pools during launch. Setting to 60 concurrent tenant creations.
Marcus (Product): Who owns partner landing content? I'll draft it if Samir supplies a short code snippet and 3-step checklist.
Samir (Eng): Snippet ready. Keep it tiny: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"partner-tenant","region":"us-east-2"}'
```
June (Marketing): Embargo is set 09:00 PT Wednesday. Blog + press release + partner emails go simultaneously. Please queue quotes by EOD.
Ella (Partnerships): Assets matrix: hero (June), logos (partners + Ivy signoff), snippet (Samir), listing screenshots (Marcus), throttles/runbook (Ruth). Any missing owners?
Ivy (Legal): Also confirm privacy blurb: "Usage data processed per Redwood and partner terms." Partners must ack.
Marcus (Product): I'll collect partner ack and finalize screenshots.
Ruth (Platform): Preflight scheduled 05:30 PT tomorrow. I'll validate redirect chain, CDN invalidation, and concurrency cap behavior.
Samir (Eng): Patch pushed to staging, CI green. Monitoring canary.
June (Marketing): UTM for partner links: ?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=launch_q2.
Ella (Partnerships): Great. If preflight green we meet Monday 08:30 PT for go/no-go. Keep this thread for blockers only.
Ruth (Platform): Preflight done: redirect chain clean, CDN purge OK, concurrency cap worked; observed 1 transient tenant create failure but client retry handled it. Marking green-with-note.
Ivy (Legal): NanoChip addendum received in thread 9approved. All legal clear.
Marcus (Product): All set from product side. Playbook draft uploaded.
Ella (Partnerships): All green. Final sync Monday 08:30 PT. Thanks team. :rocket:
